tools.name: task.approvals.listSignOffs
tools.description: Lists the instance's sign-offs, oldest first, one page at a time, the consumed ones included; with state, only those for it.

limit.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

tools.name: task.approvals.signOff
tools.description: Signs off on the instance for a gated state, as the caller. Needs the permission of one of the gate's requirements, and is refused unless it counts toward one of them now: for the instance's creator unless the requirement allows it, for a caller the requirement does not count, excludes or whose proof falls short, while the instance is in the state, and for a caller whose sign-off for the state is not yet consumed.

read.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

version.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

tools.name: task.approvals.withdrawSignOff
tools.description: Withdraws the caller's sign-off for a gated state, one not yet consumed.

tools.name: task.status.transition
tools.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.
